verdict.title: P8: Consolidated maximin - one Sumatra request, no stacked consent asks
verdict.headline: By the frozen rule, the Committee adopts P22: Kalimantan air at C007, four days of Johor Bomba, and one combined Sumatra consent ask at C020.
verdict.actNow: Move what needs no consent today: CL-415 to C007 days 1-10, three helicopters days 1-14, 60 Bomba to C121 and 40 to C120 days 1-4. Remaining Bomba held in reserve, not dispersed for appearance.
verdict.ask: One combined request: two lance teams from day 5 and the 150-person task force from day 7, together at C020 (Simpang, Jambi). Granted, it carries most of the 11.11% of ceiling; refused, we sit near 6.86%.
verdict.share: Command and safety of every ground crew at C020 remain with Indonesian authorities; Malaysia supplies personnel and equipment under their direction. Wind-member attribution and detection data for C020 passed with the request through the NADMA-BNPB channel.
verdict.reasoning: The rule was frozen before any plan existed: best weighted score. P22 scores 0.831 against P19's 0.688 and P1's 0.613, carried by klBenefit 1.00 and robustness 0.93 - one Sumatra ask rather than two, so R10's lag is incurred once. Engine: expected 11.11% of the ceiling, worst wind 5.60%, pessimistic 5.47%, optimistic 12.61%. It beats the consent-free code plan P10 (6.45%, worst wind 1.11%). It does not beat P11, the code plan that assumes consent: 15.49% expected, 9.24% worst wind, spread over three Sumatra complexes. Two honest statements follow. The gain is modest - about a ninth of what putting out every fire from day 1 could remove; against W4's 34.57 ug/m3 ceiling the worst-wind case is under 2 ug/m3 (my arithmetic). And P22's own record states its figures were not re-simulated.
verdict.minorityReport: Red Cell and Health hold, unresolved, that the plan protects the mild member W2 while leaving W4 - the worst exposure, ceiling 34.57 ug/m3 - thin; C020's W4 share is 6.40% against C005's 11.71%. The Chair records a second objection in the plan's own text: P22's figures were not re-run through simulate_plan and are carried from P7 (expected 6.86%, worst wind 1.73%). The rule chose on numbers the engine has not yet confirmed for these lines. Nothing was argued against P22 in cross-examination, which is absence of challenge, not confirmation.
verdict.replanTrigger: The Committee reconvenes if: (1) re-simulation of P22 returns below P10's 6.45% expected or below its own 5.60% worst wind; (2) the combined C020 consent is not confirmed by day 4, making the lance-team day-5 and task-force day-7 starts unachievable; (3) procedural alignment on the 18 September Kalimantan acceptance - still outstanding on 7 October - prevents C007 tasking from day 1; (4) the wind resolves toward W4, where the chosen complex is weakest and C005/C002 dominate; (5) sustained rain arrives, after which suppression carries no further value (R8).
